title: goodenia hederacea subsp. alpestris
intro: Goodenia hederacea subsp. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine Goodenia, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Goodeniaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Goodenia are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The health benefits of this plant may include reduced inflammation, improved wound healing, and enhanced immune function.
